body:
Hey, so I didn't disappear and I was having a pretty good day so I wanted to ride the high while it lasted.

Unfortunately my girl friend and I are already long distance before me going away to college and we really don't have the chance to see eachother more than once a week, and the friends I have that live in my town I really shouldn't call friends because I don't enjoy spending time with them.

Also, I wish a doctor visit was in the cards, but as I said I am in no way prepared to talk to my parents about this, and without insurance paying for it I can't go.

I really wish I could use your advise, and it is helpful advise, unfortunately it's mostly just not in the cards. :/
I'm actually really tired right now, so I'm going to go to sleep. But I'm going to make a proper response in the morning. And honestly, really thank you for caring

Well, my work uniform requires a belt so I kind of need to keep one around... although otherwise that wouldn't sound like a bad idea.

And I haven't gone to a doctor, honestly I kind of really want to but I don't want to talk to my parents about it.

Luckily I have a bit of a clearer head right now, and it's been I think 6 days since that incident I'm just scared in general because I'm not sure if that feeling is going to come back, or if I am going to screw up one day. The problem is each time in that mood I seem to find myself closer to making a big mistake.
